limitations: Only the 35 scribe.7 target purposes published in gds_layers.csv and nine explicit x.23b/c seal interactions are bound. Five package-purpose scribe records remain unresolved.
Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Unsupported transformations, fractional path outlines and unexpected data on boundary purposes are rejected.
Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching. Duplicate, overlapping or touching markers are rejected rather than merged across a possible module seam.

No module or seal marker is present in these reference blocks. Executing a non-crossing or non-overlap check against empty boundary geometry does not establish a complete-chip boundary, seal origin, width, enclosure or spacing.

All 44 selected checks have nonempty failing controls; 1 nm crossings, exact touches, containment, holes, connected fragments and hierarchy are covered. Eleven portable controls agree across Windows and Linux.
Missing or modified reports, failed selected checks and rehashed layouts carrying stale measurements fail current validation. Older saved reports require Finish rechecking.

Corrected streams retain 130 explicit current catalog messages: 44 new interactions and 86 preceding core/boundary/label/VPP records. The application periphery ledger remains unchanged. Full historical decisions retain original GDS identities.
Checkpoints, netlists, SPEF and manufacturing geometry are unchanged. This batch claims no new extraction, timing, full physical signoff or foundry acceptance.
Generated masks, RF selectors, grid semantics, frame/pad context, missing numeric definitions and remaining required density/catalog coverage are unresolved.
